title: Translation invariance of uniform expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $z\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The uniform expectation of $x\mapsto f(x+z)$ equals the uniform expectation of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
